scope: A separate research-only H2O profile and isolated seven-component runtime compatibility check. The frozen six-component generated artifact is read-only.

molecularMethod.conformerEnumeration: RDKit 2023.09.5 ETKDGv3, seed 20260829, 32 requested conformers, 0.25 angstrom pruning, MMFF94s minimum
molecularMethod.surfaceGeneration: pinned CPCM-X 1.1.0 xTB conductor surface, water invocation, epsilon=infinity
retainedRawArtifacts: non-.log retained copies of xTB and CPCM-X execution output
CPCM-X TOML input and every copied CPCM-X DB input

surfaceAndConversion.inputChargeConvention: xTB ddCOSMO native convention emitted by --cosmo
surfaceAndConversion.outputChargeConvention: xTB TM convention consumed by the pinned NIST converter
surfaceAndConversion.hydrogenBondProbability: 1-exp(-sigma_grid^2/(2*0.007^2)), applied after linear two-bin area interpolation
surfaceAndConversion.volume: deterministic union of retained CPCM cavity spheres on a 0.05 angstrom midpoint grid

waterSpecificAssertions: the retained surface contains exactly one oxygen and two hydrogens
the oxygen is geometrically bonded to both hydrogens
oxygen and hydrogen atoms are classified as OH
positive averaged oxygen segments contribute to OH
negative averaged hydrogen segments contribute to OH
OT has no segment assignment and zero profile area
OH final profile area is nonzero

independentVerification.implementation: verify_profile_semantics.py independently parses and recomputes every segment without importing the generator
assertions: native charge divided by area matches the surface column
partitioning, linear binning, and post-binning probability are independently evaluated
segment audit and emitted profile match the independent trace
every manifest-listed retained raw artifact path and SHA-256 passes independent verification
pinned executable/release-provenance identifiers and hashes pass independent verification

runtimeAcceptance.isolation: Copy the six frozen profiles into a temporary tree, append only generated H2O, execute, then delete the tree
requiredAssertions: each test point returns exactly seven finite ln-gamma and gamma values
a fresh interpreter process reproduces the complete activity grid bitwise
low-water and near-boundary compositions are exercised
